articles.title: Crypto investors are looking past market-cap rankings and back to fundamentals
articles.snippet: Investors are starting to judge crypto tokens on usage, economics and value capture rather than market-cap rank, industry executives said.

articles.title: MiCA's cleanup is creating a new scam wave across the European Union
articles.snippet: Fraudsters impersonating regulators and licensed crypto exchanges to steal funds from users forced to migrate their accounts after the EU's MiCA deadline are on the rise.

articles.title: Why the world’s second-largest Bitcoin mining power is shutting down rigs in its capital city
articles.snippet: The Energy Ministry enacted the year-round restriction to mitigate power capacity shortages, as energy-intensive mining facilities continue to strain regional grids.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips back to $63,000; MSCI threatens to exclude Strategy from indices
articles.snippet: WTI crude tops $82 a barrel, adding inflation pressure and weighing on risk assets as bond yields rise.

articles.title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
articles.snippet: Solana’s proposed fee overhaul would make resource-heavy transactions more expensive while cutting costs for simpler activity, and it increases the amount of SOL burned.
